skill.name: Route Communication Channel by Issue Type
skill.description: Determine and direct user inquiries to the appropriate communication channel (GitHub Issues, GitHub Discussions, Discord, or contact form) based on issue category and urgency.
skill.skill_body:
Classify the incoming user request by type (bug report, feature request, usage question, general feedback, or private inquiry). Match the classification to the preferred channel: GitHub Issues for bugs, feature requests, and documentation improvements; GitHub Discussions for usage questions, feature ideas, community showcase, and general feedback; Discord for real-time help and community discussions; contact form for private inquiries. Forward the request with full context to the selected channel.

## Objective

Route incoming user requests to correct support channel
## Applicable Signals

- Request contains error logs or reproduction steps (bug signal)
- Request proposes new capability or enhancement (feature signal)
- Request asks how to use existing functionality (usage signal)
- Request is general comment or suggestion (feedback signal)
- Request contains sensitive or private information (privacy signal)

## Contraindications

- Issue is already assigned to a channel
- User explicitly specifies preferred contact method
- Communication is internal team-only
- Request requires immediate security escalation

## Workflow Steps

- {'step': 1, 'action': 'Classify request type', 'detail': 'Identify whether incoming request is bug report, feature request, usage question, general feedback, documentation improvement, or private inquiry'}
- {'step': 2, 'action': 'Match to channel', 'detail': 'Map classification to channel: GitHub Issues (bugs, feature requests, documentation improvements); GitHub Discussions (usage questions, feature ideas, community showcase, general feedback); Discord (real-time help, community discussions, feature announcements); Contact Form (private inquiries)'}
- {'step': 3, 'action': 'Prepare forwarding', 'detail': 'Preserve full request context, user information, and any attachments or code samples'}
- {'step': 4, 'action': 'Route to channel', 'detail': 'Submit request to selected channel with appropriate formatting and metadata'}

## Constraints

- Public channels are preferred for technical discussions
- Private inquiries must use contact form
- All forwarded requests must include original context and user identifier

## Cautions

- Ensure sensitive information in private inquiries is not posted to public channels
- Verify channel-specific formatting requirements before forwarding
- Maintain audit trail of routing decisions for support analytics

## Output Contract

- User request successfully forwarded to correct channel with full context preserved
- Confirmation that GitHub issue or discussion was created, Discord message was posted, or contact form was submitted
- User receives acknowledgment and expected response timeline for selected channel
